description: Source code implementing netlink family management functions for Linux, including parsing attributes, listing, and retrieving family info via netlink socket communication.

classes.name: GenlOp
classes.description: Represents a generic netlink operation with ID and Flags.

classes.name: GenlMulticastGroup
classes.description: Represents a multicast group with ID and Name.

classes.name: GenlFamily
classes.description: Represents a generic netlink family with attributes, operations, and multicast groups.

methods.name: parseOps
methods.description: Parses byte slice into a list of GenlOp objects.

methods.name: parseMulticastGroups
methods.description: Parses byte slice into a list of GenlMulticastGroup objects.

methods.name: parseAttributes
methods.description: Parses Netlink attributes into a GenlFamily object.

methods.name: parseFamilies
methods.description: Parses list of byte slices into list of GenlFamily objects.

methods.name: GenlFamilyList
methods.description: Retrieves list of all GenlFamily objects via netlink.

methods.name: GenlFamilyGet
methods.description: Retrieves a specific GenlFamily by name via netlink.
